name: gate-rush-android
description: Gate Rush packaged as an Android app with Capacitor

scripts.check: node tools/build.js && node tools/sim.js --runs 2 && node tools/browser-check.js
scripts.setup:android: node tools/build.js && npx cap add android && npx cap sync android && python3 tools/android_setup.py
scripts.sync: node tools/build.js && npx cap sync android && python3 tools/android_setup.py
